lanes.defer_reason: Mandatory after reviewer output exists; forbidden during preparation

values.failure_policy: Fail closed without dispatch, finding acceptance, publication, merge, WP-20 release, or closeout on incomplete #5356 terminal truth, handoff mutation, claim collision, stale/non-ancestral target, mutable or incomplete corpus/receipt identity, undisclosed reviewer control, malformed output, evidence/inference confusion, secret or host-bound data, new dependency, budget breach, deferred gate, stale review, red CI, or absent post-merge proof.
